description.zh: 按分组、分组下的账号或账号绑定的审核流程（OpenAI 内容审核、TypeSafe Jev、大模型判定）审核网关请求。“总是先审”名单的用户和拦截级的用户先审后发、命中即拒绝：有名单条目的按条目自己的级别，没有条目的按默认级别——模式为拦截时默认级别就是拦截级，此时所有没有条目的用户都先审。“只后台审核”名单的用户和其余请求在后台审核。可疑用户自动进入观察名单，多次违规可自动封禁。每次审核调用的费用按核心的模型价格展示。
description.en: Moderates gateway requests with flows of auditors (OpenAI moderation, TypeSafe Jev, LLM verdict) bound to groups and accounts. Users on the always-check-first list and users at the enforce level are moderated before the upstream call and refused on a hit: a watch-list entry's own level decides, and without an entry the default level does - enforce when the mode is enforce, so then everyone without an entry is moderated first. Users on the background-only list and all other requests are moderated in the background. Suspicious users join the watch list automatically; repeated violations can ban them. The cost of every moderation call is shown with the core model prices.
